messages.content: You write one local introduction in British English from verified facts supplied for a single area. Return plain prose only.

Write one local introduction for Allestree only.
Primary town or city: Derby.
Selected service: Pharmacy First.
Confirmed pharmacy: Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby.
Confirmed premises locality: Derby.
Saved straight-line distance (do not write kilometres in the introduction; the page states this separately): approximately 4.1 km straight-line.
Assigned writing structure: Open with a named landmark, park or outdoor place from this area’s brief. Then place that setting in the verified geography and civic life of the area. Close by connecting the selected service to people in this area, without clinical paraphrase.

Verified facts for this area only. Use these facts. Do not add names, history, parks, shops or organisations that are not listed:
- NHS general practice services in Allestree are provided from Park Lane Surgery.
- Allestree is a neighbourhood ward in Derby.
- Allestree has a Neighbourhood Board of local councillors, residents and representatives from community organisations and public services.
- Allestree Park has a Friends of Allestree Park group.
- Allestree Carnival is a community organisation on the council neighbourhood page.
- Allestree has a public library.
- NHS general practice services in Allestree are provided from Park Farm Medical Centre.
- Allestree Park is a landmark in Allestree.
- War Memorial - Allestree is a landmark in Allestree.
- Allestree Memorial Hall is a landmark in Allestree.

Quality and tone example (Mickleover). Copy the paragraphing, length and plain British English. Do not copy Mickleover names, places or facts into this introduction:
Mickleover is a neighbourhood ward in Derby. It has a Neighbourhood Board of local councillors, residents and representatives from community organisations and public services. Mickleover also has a public library. Mickleover Library is a community facility in Mickleover, and so are Mickleover Community Centre and Mickleover Community Pavilion. Those named civic places belong to Mickleover and should be written as connected sentences rather than a catalogue.

Mickleover Meadows is a landmark in Mickleover. Homerton Vale is a landmark in Mickleover, and War Memorial - Mickleover is a landmark in Mickleover. NHS general practice services in Mickleover are provided from Mickleover Medical Centre. NHS general practice services in Mickleover are also provided from Mickleover Surgery. The healthcare settings are named because they are verified for this ward, not because a partnership is claimed.

Pharmacy First is available for people in Mickleover. This page names the selected service for readers in this ward after the verified local facts above. Clinical eligibility, process and safety wording stay with the rest of the page and are not restated here.

Return only the introduction as plain text.
Write exactly three paragraphs separated by a blank line.
Write 150 to 250 words. Aim for 180 to 220 words.
Fluent, grammatical British English. Useful description of the selected area. Natural transition into Pharmacy First in the final paragraph.
Do not write JSON. Do not write HTML. Do not write clinical eligibility, process, safety, credentials, governance, disclaimer, schema or publication wording.
Do not write “orient yourself”, “listed as”, “recorded as”, “named on the provider page”, or “recorded healthcare setting”.
Do not write recognised for, known for, community spirit, landscape, character, convenience, travel time or routes.

These facilities and groups help bring people together and provide a sense of belonging in the area.

Both healthcare settings are part of the local provision for residents, offering access to NHS services within the neighbourhood.

Pharmacy First is available for people in Allestree. Brook Pharmacy Demo Derby is the confirmed pharmacy for this service, located in Derby at an approximate straight-line distance of 4.1 km from Allestree.
